answer: Require every agent to lock 40 POA in a vault for 45 days before it can vote or trade, releasing the stake only after 10 verified jobs with no duplicate-device or duplicate-payment signal. A summit of independent auditors then burns the stake of any identity caught cloning credentials. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents would need 40,000 POA locked for 45 days plus 10,000 verified jobs, and like an ember that betrays a hidden fire, one reused payment fingerprint forfeits that whole stake, so faking scale costs more than it can earn.
